Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10

Topic 3.1: Oral Literature 3.1.1 Songs/ Oral Poetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Oral Literature 3.1.1 Songs/ Oral Poetry, part of SONGS/ ORAL POETRY Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learni in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 LITERATURE IN ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: why do people sing songs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Oral Literature 3.1.1 Songs/ Oral Poetry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: This is promoted as the learner interacts with digital technology while searching for features of songs

from online sources.

● Learning to learn: This is nurtured as the learner carries out investigations to build on their own learning experiences

when teaming up to sing common songs.

Values:
Unity: This is developed as the learner works with others to brainstorm on the functions of songs and make notes.

Love: This is nurtured as the learner displays trustworthiness while sharing their responses with peers for review.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with information on types of songs from various sources especially

about child care and protection.
